root_cause: powerhouse_forecasts rows stay active after their own expected_by/horizon_end because only forecasts with a calibration obligation are ever expired. The recommendation generator filters on status active or claimed only, so the CPNL forecast (opens 6 Oct 2026) kept producing daily blogs; 8 of the last 10 daily blogs were about it and the reader-ready gate had to block them.

observed_evidence.source: powerhouse_forecasts (11,626 active, 3,826 past horizon on 2026-11-05), content_publication_obligations, GitHub run 42082695079 (EXPIRED_FUTURE_EVENT_CLAIM)

fix: Migration 20261105190000 adds powerhouse_expire_stale_forecasts_v1 (one update: active/claimed with horizon before the Amsterdam date become expired) and one hourly pg_cron job. No change to the generator, the publisher or any gate.
prevention_rule: Before any material PR check the exact live supabase_migrations.schema_migrations version/name sequence against executable supabase/migrations SQL and canonical migration-history.lock.json, and block on mismatch. Never invent or apply an already-applied version twice, never delete SQL, do not bypass the original protected migration preflight.

invariants: only active or claimed rows change

open_obligation: SQL provider migration already applied and independently listed as #810; source-lock parity is repaired on protected candidate and remains EVIDENCE_DUE until Required/CodeQL and protected merge. Original scheduled expiry job results and next natural blog freshness require their own provider/consumer readback; no assertion of visitor or revenue uplift.
reuse_guidance: Change the expiry rule only in the migration function and its test.
